group_assessment.weighting: Adult mouse kainate temporal-lobe epilepsy models; a GSK3 inhibitor is used as a Wnt activator and the endpoints are granule-cell histology and Axin2, with no seizure, EEG or behaviour readout. NOT WWOX EVIDENCE.

entries.proposition: Mice were adults (8-10 weeks): this is not a developing-brain model, and the drug was given for 14 days starting 24 h after kainate.
entries.snippet: Animal experiments were performed using 8–10-week-old wild-type C57Bl6/J mice

entries.proposition: Dose: SB415286 10 mg/kg/day i.p. in a DMSO and polyethylene glycol vehicle, a single dose level.
entries.snippet: SB415286 was dosed at 10 mg/kg/day IP [51–53].

entries.proposition: The compound is a GSK3-beta inhibitor used to activate canonical Wnt; its activity as a kinase inhibitor in the mouse brain is the mechanism, not a selective Wnt ligand.
entries.snippet: SB415286 is a highly selective CNS-penetrant anilinomaleimide GSK3b inhibitor with established beta-catenin activating properties [43] and a half-life of 20 h [51].

entries.proposition: Axin2 rose after a single dose and stayed up at 24 h (about 5- and 7-fold on the paper figures).
entries.snippet: Wnt activity increased 5 ± 0.94 fold 3-hours after SB415286 treatment and remained 7 ± 1.25 fold increased after 24-hours

entries.proposition: The epilepsy outcome is histological: dispersion, migration, cell count and primary dendrite angle of POMC-GFP immature granule cells. Seizures were scored behaviourally only for 2 h at kainate induction to define status epilepticus.
entries.snippet: Seizures were scored behaviorally for 2-hours after completion of surgery in the IHK model and after initiation of injections in the IPK model by modified Racine scale

entries.proposition: In the unilateral model SB415286 reduced dispersion, migration and the contralateral cell count increase.
entries.snippet: When animals were treated with Wnt activator SB415286, granule cell dispersion (Fig. 3C, p < 0.01) and granule cell radial migration (Fig. 3D, p < 0.001) were significantly reduced in the ipsilateral dentate gyrus after IHK

entries.proposition: In the bilateral model SB415286 had no effect on dispersion, migration or granule cell count; only dendrite angle changed.
entries.snippet: Wnt activation with SB415286 had no effect on granule cell layer dispersion, granule cell migration and granule cell count after IPK or IPS (Fig. 4B–D).

entries.proposition: Dendrite angle in IPK was prevented by SB415286; this is the only histological marker rescued in the bilateral model.
entries.snippet: We also observed that pro-epileptogenic remodeling of proximal dendrites was prevented with Wnt activation after IPK (Fig. 4E).

entries.proposition: Wnt signalling (Axin2) was below baseline only in the ipsilateral epileptogenic zone after IHK and unchanged on the contralateral side; SB415286 restored baseline.
entries.snippet: In the hemisphere contralateral to IHK injection, Wnt signaling levels in immature dentate granule cells were unchanged after IHK, compared to intrahippocampal saline controls (Fig. 5C–D).

entries.proposition: SB415286 raised Axin2 above baseline in saline-treated control mice, i.e. an over-activation arm exists.
entries.snippet: As expected, SB415286 treatment in intrahippocampal saline injected control mice increased Wnt activity above baseline in both hemispheres.

entries.proposition: Counter-indication carried from earlier work by the same authors: a related GSK3 inhibitor impaired cognitive testing in non-epileptic control mice, which the authors read as supra-physiological Wnt in a normal brain.
entries.snippet: in our prior work we observed that saline control mice treated with Wnt activator Chir99021 demonstrated impaired cognitive testing compared to vehicle treated controls

entries.proposition: Each group has n = 6; the statistics section states male and female mice were pooled.
entries.snippet: For each experiment, n per group was 6, male and female mice were used

entries.proposition: The authors themselves tie the finding to earlier work on a related GSK3 inhibitor, where seizure burden fell in the unilateral model, and note that earlier work did not change dispersion, migration or neurogenesis.
entries.snippet: Furthermore, Wnt activation using Chir99021 during epileptogenesis in the IHK model of unilateral TLE reduced seizure burden during treatment and after treatment withdrawal
